primer: TSMC (NYSE: TSM) earns a price-blind COMPOUNDER_PASS rating as October 2026 sales jumped 59.7% YoY and net cash reached $93.64B. On November 20, 2026, TSM fell 9.48% to $318.71 on 2.38x volume and broke our $348.00 stop inside a US Downtrend. Although facts_US tags Stage 1 at the $318.48 low, snapshots_US confirms STAGE_4 (CAP_REJECTED) far below its 50-day ($422.15) and 200-day ($403.56) averages. We exit all 2.3344 Schwab shares (~$744.00) into 100% Cash and rate new capital REJECTED (TIER_0) until a new base forms.
